summary: Implement one approved repeatable-work candidate in its chosen durable carrier without rediscovery or scope expansion.

scenarios.title: Implement an accepted candidate
scenarios.prompt: Use the productize-repeatable-work skill to implement accepted candidate R1 exactly as recorded in this conversation.
scenarios.outcome: One narrow instruction, script, skill, hook, automation, or plugin change with relevant validation and no rediscovery.

scenarios.title: Reject a broader carrier
scenarios.prompt: Use the productize-repeatable-work skill for R2, but stop if the accepted target no longer fits the current repository state.
scenarios.outcome: Either a verified minimal artifact or a revised proposal explaining why the recorded target would now broaden scope.
